0.1.45: New: TikTok videos preview instantly and you can scrub the whole video. Before, the preview had to download first and stopped after one minute.
Fixed: TikTok clips started and ended a few frames late, and some lost the creator's voice. They now start and end where you mark them, in full quality, with the video's own sound.
Fixed: a clip whose Out point sat exactly on a frame could lose its last frame.
Fixed: when a site briefly refused a download, HEVC and ProRes exports could come out as H.264. Klipprr now tries again and keeps the format you picked.
0.1.44: Fixed: on Windows, some videos from your own files (iPhone clips, HEVC recordings) wouldn't preview. They now open and play.
New: Klipprr asks once whether you want to share usage data, like which links fail to load. It helps me fix problems before you have to report them. Change it any time in Settings.
0.1.43: Fixed: clips could start a frame after the one you marked, and some opened on a black frame. Every clip now starts on the exact frame you mark, from YouTube, Twitch, X, Instagram and your own files.
Fixed: long local recordings, like a 1-hour OBS stream, took a while to load and jumped back to the start when you scrubbed. They now open instantly and scrub smoothly.
Improved: 4K exports were softer than they should be. They now keep the detail of the original.
New: choose H.264, HEVC or ProRes 422 when you export, and set your default in Settings.
Improved: paste a link and it loads by itself, even if you copied a few words along with it.
